Name: NoodleJubblies' Red Panda Cats
Author: NoodleJubblies
Description:
Four years ago, a mod author named [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/messenger/5687014/#]Grruilw[/url] made a mod that did something similar, however it required Adopt'n'Skin, which hasn't been updated in years and tends to cause stuttering in-game, as well as some sprites not loading properly. 

So, I decided to redraw the sprites from scratch to make them a bit more accurate to a real red panda, as well as making the mod require less things to work properly.

All this mod does is use CP to replace the first cat color option with the red panda sprite I drew. ^__^

My husband works with red pandas at our local conservation zoo, and I really wanted to surprise him by putting his favorite red panda he ever met, Sue, into our multiplayer game. Needless to say, he was tearing up he was so happy! So I decided to make another one to replace another cat. xD

[b][i][u]Simply drag the folder into your /Mods folder and let SMAPI and CP do the rest.[/u][/i][/b]

Downloads.Description: Change the first two colours of cats to two different shades of red pandas! ^_^

Manifest.Name: Red Panda Cats
Manifest.Description: Changes cat and cat1 skins into RED PANDAS
